description: Paginated UK bike-brand catalogue from Cyclesite, ordered by stock level, for checking a brand name, listing the options or paging through the catalogue. Stock counts are returned as bands (none / 1-5 / 6-25 / 26-100 / 100+); Cyclesite doesn't expose precise per-brand inventory. Example: 'what brands of e-bike are available?'.
name: list_brands
